triples = [[3, 8, 5], [6, 6, 6], [5, 8, 5], [13, 5, 12], [2, 9, 4], [7, 4, 7], [8, 6, 7], [4, 9, 6]]
triples.each do |triple|
  a, b, c = triple.sort
  if a + b <= c
    result = 'not a triangle'
  else
    side = a == c ? 'equilateral' : a == b || b == c ? 'isosceles' : 'scalene'
  puts "#{triple.join(' ')}: #{result}"
